title: Artist Management System
description: Artist, music and booking management with three role-based workspaces (artist manager, artist, user), analytics, playlists, audio previews and an audit trail.

title: Hospital Management Application
description: Patients, doctors and appointments with visit history, outpatient queue and triage, vitals, billing and role-based workspaces for the people running a clinic.

title: Multi-Factor Authentication
description: Account-security product: password sign-in with a second step (e-mailed one-time code, authenticator app or passkey), recovery options, step-up checks, sessions and an admin console.

title: E-commerce ShopLane
description: Online store with three roles: shoppers, sellers and admins. Product pages, compare, checkout, order tracking and seller and admin dashboards.

title: Social Media Platform (Orbit)
description: Social network with profiles, following, hashtags, comments, polls, reactions, direct messages, private accounts and a moderation toolkit.

title: Stock Market Portfolio
description: Portfolio and trading tracker with paper trading, realized and unrealized P&L, allocation, a screener, goals, price alerts and printable reports.

title: Chat Room
description: Real-time chat room with presence, typing indicators, threads, reactions, direct messages and private rooms. The static site runs peer-to-peer, browser to browser.

title: News Outlet
description: News publication platform where readers, writers, editors and admins share one app: editorial review workflow, live blogs, newsletters and personalised feeds.

title: Bookstore (Folio Books)
description: Online bookstore built around books and readers: multiple editions per book, an in-browser e-book reader, reading goals, book clubs and a role-based back office.

title: College Mini Project (FoodShop)
description: Food-ordering app grown from a college mini project into a full-stack app with accounts, roles, a live kitchen queue, order tracking and an admin area.

title: Movieland
description: Movie discovery app: search and filter, named lists, ratings, a viewing diary, stats, recommendations and a quiz. Works offline as an installable PWA.

title: Calculator Hub
description: 116 calculators in one static, offline-capable site: a smart calculator, scientific, programmer and graphing modes, finance tools and converters.

title: Login Templates
description: Two login page designs with a complete demo flow: sign in, register with a password strength meter, forgot password and a signed-in state.

title: RWT Tasks
description: Two front-end practice tasks: a coming-soon slider with autoplay controls and a login form.

title: Simplilearn Clone
description: Front-end practice clone of an online-learning homepage with a searchable course catalog and light and dark themes. Sample content, not affiliated with the original.
